text_block_list.name: Social Studies Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for the next question... Stay Gold-san.
—Stay Gold-san?

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text: They just left!

text_block_list.name: Social Studies Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Again...!?
We can't go on like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The weather is so lovely.
It'd be a waste to stay cooped up inside.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's rare for you to reach out to me. What's on your mind, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This is regarding your misconduct.
...Do you have any idea what this is about?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, who knows?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...This has been seen as a problem for quite some time.
Apparently, she slipped out of history class today as well...
As the student council, we cannot simply overlook this."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, being too caring can be tough in its own way, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I hear you haven't turned in your history makeup assignment either.
In that case, straight to the library we go."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really can't stand feeling so suffocated.
—Alright, I know!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, how long has it been since I properly opened a textbook?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I've seen this statue before!
I stopped by during my travels; the people and the weather
were so mild, it was a wonderful country.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with that question, then.
Please answer regarding the officer's life and historical background.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Oh yeah, do you know about this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This officer and his wife were actually famous for being an incredibly devoted couple!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Apparently, the couple would always take walks together and invariably sit down on the same bench to chat.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Back home, that bench is called the "Married Couple's Bench,"
and people consider it a bit of a good luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A huge crowd gathered, hoping to share in the love of the married couple.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oho... so this is the "Couples' Bench." There sure are a lot of pairs here. ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Ugh... Uuu..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Hey there, young lady, what happened?"

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... I had a fight with my partner...
It was over something so trivial,
but I just ended up being so stubborn..."

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
""He and I... spent a lot of time here.
I thought he might come after me since it's a place full of memories, but... it's over now...""

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"It's supposed to be a blessed bench, right?
Maybe it'll offer some guidance."

text_block_list.name: Local Man
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... haa...! Found you!
Wait, who are you...?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm just a passerby.
More importantly... here, why don't you have a seat?’"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"If you're out of breath like that,
you won't even be able to say what you want to say, right?"

text_block_list.name: Local Man
text_block_list.text:
""......*sigh* Um... my bad.
I lost my temper and took it too far.""

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
""......N-No, I should be the one...!
I'm so sorry...!""

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's great.
Wishing you two a long and happy life together.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The love left behind by that couple... is still weaving stories to this day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you believe...
history is an unbroken chain of people's feelings?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, it's just the idle rambling of a frivolous traveler.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......
Well then... please write a report on that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Viewing "feelings" omitted from historical records as history itself... fascinating.
There shouldn't be any issue with submitting this content.

text_block_list.name: Social Studies Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
It's about Stay Gold...!

text_block_list.name: Social Studies Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Her report was wonderful.
Stay Gold-san... Through your travels,
you touch living history each and every day, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Did you get praised for your history report?
choice_data_list: Yeah! They were raving about it!
Yeah! She was raving about it!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's the make-up assignment for skipping class.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's the make-up assignment for skipping class.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm learning in my own way.
I'm just not very good with theory, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that by listening to various opinions
and engaging in discussions during class, she might
make some new discoveries.
choice_data_list: I think it will broaden your horizons.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I understand.
I'll be sure to keep your words in mind.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Whether they'll remember or not, though, I have no idea.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha! What're you talking about?
I always let you listen, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: If that's what you want, I'll tell you more.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: About the "history" living inside me!
